kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتقايض (form VI)
# نَتَقَايَضُ (nataqāyaḍu) /na.ta.qaː.ja.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
# نَتَقَايَضَ (nataqāyaḍa) /na.ta.qaː.ja.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
# نَتَقَايَضْ (nataqāyaḍ) /na.ta.qaː.jadˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
